text:
Elena (Sales): Shadowfax (fintech prospect) asked for a perf benchmark this week. Req: 500 qps sustained, p95 <= 100ms on text-gen with 16k context, CMEK + SOC2-level handling. Need runbook, cost estimate, and any enterprise blockers. Who can own?
Alex K: I can lead the benchmark. Quick Q: what's the model family/size? 7B, 13B, or 70B? Also will they accept a quantized variant?
Elena (Sales): They prefer 13B for quality but will accept 7B if cost/capacity better. They insist on customer-managed key (CMEK).
Maria G: For sustained 500 qps we should target Dedicated reserved capacity. Rough sketch: 4 x A100-equivalent nodes as baseline, autoscale to 6 for bursts. I'll draft a cost estimate once we pick model/quantization.
Sanjay P: Load plan proposal: warmup -> ramp -> sustain -> burst. Details: 10m warmup; 20m ramp to 500 qps; 30m sustain at 500 qps; 15m burst to 800 qps; cooldown. We'll use k6 harness and our synthetic prompts.
Sanjay P: k6 snippet (local harness):
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  const url = 'https://internal-redwood/api/generate';
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood/13B', prompt: '<<short prompt>>' });
  const params = { headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } };
  http.post(url, payload, params);
  sleep(0.02); // tune to target qps per VU
}
```
Maria G: Config notes: enable prefix/KV caching, batching config: target_batch_size=64, max_batch_latency_ms=50. Also set min_replicas to avoid cold starts.
Priya S (Security): For CMEK + SOC2 we'll need Shadowfax's KMS ARN and an encrypted dataflow diagram. They also asked for a copy of our pen-test summary and network diagram. I'll start populating their security questionnaire.
Elena (Sales): Timeline: they want preliminary numbers by EOD Friday. Feasible?
Alex K: Preliminary smoke + cost estimate feasible by Friday. Full sustained-run validation and regression (including tail analysis) likely needs until Monday unless we prioritize. If they want a hard Friday deadline we can do a daytime run and flag caveats.
OpsBot: deploy-benchmark-run scheduled by @Alex K for 2024-08-02T15:10Z
Sanjay P: Note on cold starts for 13B on our Dedicated infra: cold p95 spikes ~200-250ms if replicas spin. With warmup and pre-warmed KV cache we typically hit ~90-110ms p95.
Alex K: Quick morning smoke: 20m run at 420 qps with 13B (int8 quantized) -> p50=45ms, p95=118ms, p99=210ms. Tail due to replica churn and a noisy VM in one AZ.
Maria G: Mitigations: set min_replicas=4 and prewarm policy, sticky routing to avoid cross-AZ thrash, enable fallback to 7B model-variant when p95 > 150ms to preserve SLO.
Priya S (Security): Customer requires HSM-backed key for CMEK. We support HSM but onboarding will need a short legal addendum + Ops checklist. I'll prepare the checklist items.
Infra-Oncall: FYI - if we set min_replicas=4 for 13B we should provision GPU memory headroom; I'll coordinate node sizing with infra.
Elena (Sales): OK — Alex + Maria + Priya, please drop a short runbook + cost ballpark in this thread. I'll assemble a one-pager for Shadowfax and include the security checklist.
Alex K: Will post runbook, k6 commands, and a summarized run result (including raw p95/p99 numbers and mitigation steps) in ~30m.
Maria G: I'll attach a cost delta table: Dedicated baseline vs burst, and impact of quantization and fallback.
Priya S (Security): I'll attach the security questionnaire answers and a list of docs Shadowfax requested.
Elena (Sales): Thanks team — let's treat this as high priority. I'll loop in legal if Priya flags the CMEK addendum. :thumbsup:
